title: Card Holding Allowances by Tier — Pocketwire Visa Debit Card
content:
A customer can hold more than one Pocketwire Visa Debit Card at a time. The counts below are read from the tier of the card being issued.

| Card tier | Non-closed physical cards per customer | Non-closed reusable virtual cards per customer | Single-use virtual cards issued per calendar month |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Visa Classic Debit | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit | 1 | 2 | 0 |
| Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit | 1 | 3 | 5 |
| Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit | 1 | 5 | 10 |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit | 1 | 10 | 20 |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit | 1 | 20 | 50 |

**What each column counts**

- *Physical cards*: physical cards in any status other than closed.
- *Reusable virtual cards*: virtual cards, other than single-use cards, in any status other than closed.
- *Single-use virtual cards*: single-use virtual cards issued within one calendar month, whatever their status.

**Points of reading**

- A zero means none. Pocketwire Visa Classic Debit and Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit allow 0 single-use virtual cards per calendar month, so no single-use virtual card is issued on those tiers.
- On every tier the physical-card count is 1.
